instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the application strictly follows the color tokens provided. Avoid all generic blues, purples, or dark corporate colors.
Use 'Outfit' for all headings and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for body text. Add 'Caveat' for signature elements.
All interactive elements and key information must have a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button').
Rely heavily on whitespace (p-12, p-16, p-24) to create a premium Apple/Canva feel.
Apply rounded-3xl to cards and images to maintain the soft, welcoming, non-corporate aesthetic.
Do NOT build generic table-based layouts for text. Use Bento grids, overlapping elements, or well-spaced single columns.
Use lucide-react icons, specifically integrating Compass, Globe, MapPin motifs where applicable but subtly.
Ensure all 12 pages (8 core, 4 stubs) are routed and exist in the React application.
Implement the Calendly placeholder using a Shadcn Dialog modal when the 'Book Consultation' button is clicked.
Use pure HTML + Tailwind for structural layouts on marketing pages, using Shadcn only for complex interactives (Forms, Modals, Accordions).
